scope_options.label: Fresh painting
scope_options.description: For new plaster, or walls being redone from the base: one or two coats of wall putty, a coat of primer, then two or more coats of paint. Berger lists 1–2 coats of putty, a primer coat and at least 2–3 coats of paint for fresh painting.

scope_options.label: Repaint
scope_options.description: For walls that already have a sound putty base: clean, scrape loose paint, touch up putty where needed, then primer and two coats of paint. AapkaPainter puts a repaint 25–40% below fresh painting and HomeTriangle 15–25% below, because less putty is needed.

materials.label: Wall putty and primer (undercoats)
materials.description: Undercoats applied before the paint. Berger states that fresh painting needs 1–2 coats of putty, a coat of primer and at least 2–3 coats of paint. AapkaPainter attributes the higher cost of fresh painting to full putty work (two coats) and primer, and puts a repaint over sound walls 25–40% lower.

duration_days.basis: Planning range across sub-services, not a sourced total: NoBroker gives 3–5 days for a 2 BHK interior, 5–7 days for a 3 BHK interior (up to 15 days in some cases) and 2–6 days for a house exterior. Interior and exterior work done together take longer.

questions_to_ask: Is your rate per sq ft of paintable wall and ceiling area, and how will you measure it (room by room, with doors and windows deducted)?
Which brand and product will you use on each surface, and will the paint arrive in sealed containers that I can check?
Is this priced as fresh painting (full putty, primer and two coats) or as a repaint (putty touch-up, primer and two coats)?
How will you treat damp patches, cracks and peeling paint before painting, and is that included in the rate?
Are ceilings, doors, windows, grills and other wood or metal surfaces included, or priced separately?
For exterior work, is scaffolding or rope access included, and who is responsible for site safety?
Does the price include GST, furniture moving and covering, and cleanup?
How many painters will work, how many days will the job take, and what warranty will you give in writing?
common_mistakes: Comparing per-sq-ft rates without checking what they include; sources quote labour-only rates (for example AapkaPainter's ₹16–₹26 per sq ft in Pune) alongside all-inclusive rates with paint, putty and primer.
Treating carpet area as paintable area; wall and ceiling area is about 2.5 to 3.5 times the carpet area (Asian Paints uses 2.5, AapkaPainter 3.2, NoBroker 3.5).
Painting over damp or seeping walls without fixing the source; Asian Paints notes that moisture trapped under the paint film causes blistering, peeling and flaking within weeks or months.
Skipping putty and primer on new or patchy plaster to save cost; Berger lists 1–2 coats of putty and a primer coat as part of fresh painting.
Painting exteriors in the monsoon or straight after rain; Berger advises waiting 24–48 hours after rainfall, and NoBroker notes that rain within about 4 hours of a coat can wash the film away.
Accepting a quote that names only a grade such as 'premium emulsion' instead of the brand and product, which makes quotes impossible to compare.
Choosing distemper for walls that need regular cleaning; Nerolac describes distemper as less resistant to stains and moisture than emulsion.
quote_checklist: Paintable area in sq ft and how it was measured (walls, ceilings, deductions for doors and windows)
Surfaces included: walls, ceilings, doors, windows, grills, exterior parapets and compound walls
Brand and product for each surface, with number of coats
Preparation: cleaning, scraping, crack filling, number of putty coats, primer
Treatment of damp or seepage before painting, or a note that it is excluded
Scaffolding or rope access for exterior work
Furniture moving, floor and fitting protection, and cleanup
Number of painters, start date and duration
Written warranty: period, issuer and exclusions
Whether GST is included
Payment schedule linked to stages of work

faq.q: How much does house painting cost in Pune per sq ft?
faq.a: It depends on the paint grade and on how much preparation the walls need. Our draft models, built from sources retrieved in October 2026 (several of them national rather than Pune-specific), give these labour-and-material rates per sq ft of paintable area. Interior: distemper ₹7–₹20 (expected ₹12), entry-level emulsion ₹9–₹30 (₹15), premium emulsion such as Apcolite ₹14–₹40 (₹22), luxury emulsion such as Royale ₹23–₹55 (₹35), texture ₹80–₹400 (₹140). Exterior: entry-level emulsion ₹13–₹30 (₹18), weatherproof emulsion ₹18–₹45 (₹32), premium weatherproof systems ₹20–₹68 (₹37). Exterior texture has no model yet: AapkaPainter gives ₹55–₹85 per sq ft (labour and material, Chennai) and Nerolac about ₹60 for basic finishes, possibly without labour. These are indicative ranges, not quotations.

faq.q: How is paintable area worked out from carpet area?
faq.a: Paintable area is the wall and ceiling surface to be painted, which is larger than the floor area. Asian Paints' budget calculator multiplies carpet area by 2.5, AapkaPainter uses 3.2 (it says 3 to 3.5) and NoBroker uses 3.5. Our presets use 3.2, so a 2 BHK with 750 sq ft of carpet area is taken as about 2,400 sq ft. For a quote, NoBroker suggests measuring the length and height of each wall, subtracting windows and doors, and adding the ceilings.

faq.q: What does it cost to paint a 2 BHK flat in Pune?
faq.a: With the 2,400 sq ft preset and the expected rates in our draft models, interior painting comes to about ₹28,800 with distemper, ₹36,000 with an entry-level emulsion, ₹52,800 with a premium emulsion and ₹84,000 with a luxury emulsion. AapkaPainter quotes ₹38,000–₹60,000 for a standard 2 BHK interior in Pune. Urban Company (from ₹12,999) and HomeTriangle (from ₹12,899) advertise starting prices for unfurnished 2 BHK flats in Pune; HomeTriangle says the final price is set after a site visit.

faq.q: Should I choose distemper or emulsion?
faq.a: Distemper costs less (₹7–₹20 per sq ft in our model against ₹9–₹30 for an entry-level emulsion). Nerolac describes it as less resistant to stains and moisture than emulsion and suggests it for ceilings and low-traffic rooms; NoBroker notes it is not waterproof. Nerolac describes emulsion as water-based, low-odour and more washable than distemper, which matters on walls that get wiped often.

NoBroker gives about 3–5 days for a 2 BHK flat and 5–7 days for a 3 BHK, and says some jobs take up to 15 days. AapkaPainter says two painters finish a 2 BHK in 4–5 working days including drying time between coats. NoBroker gives 2–6 days for a house exterior, depending on size, crew and weather.

faq.q: Do the rates include labour and GST?
faq.a: The models use rates that include paint, putty, primer and labour wherever the source says so. Labour-only rates vary widely between sources: Asian Paints gives ₹8–₹25 per sq ft nationally, HomeTriangle ₹4–₹12, AapkaPainter ₹16–₹26 for a full interior job in Pune and NoBroker ₹20–₹50 in Pune. None of the sources says whether GST is included, so ask the contractor to state it.

faq.q: When should exterior painting be done?
faq.a: Outside the monsoon, on dry walls. Berger advises waiting 24–48 hours after rainfall before painting, provided there is airflow, and NoBroker notes that rain within about 4 hours of a coat can wash the paint film away. Fix leaks and seepage first: Asian Paints notes that moisture trapped under paint causes blistering and peeling.

questions_to_ask: Is your rate per sq ft of paintable area, and will you measure walls and ceilings room by room, deducting doors and windows?
Which brand and product will you use on the walls and on the ceilings in each room?
Is the job priced as fresh painting (full putty, primer and two coats) or as a repaint (putty touch-up, primer and two coats)?
How many coats of putty, primer and paint are included?
How will you treat damp patches, cracks and peeling paint, and is that included?
Are doors, windows, grills, wardrobes and ceilings included or priced separately?
Will you move and cover furniture, floors and fittings, and clean up afterwards?
How many painters will work and how many days will the job take, including drying time between coats?
common_mistakes: Comparing rates without checking inclusions; a labour-only rate looks cheaper than an all-inclusive rate but excludes paint, putty and primer.
Using carpet area as the paintable area; walls and ceilings add up to about 2.5–3.5 times the carpet area.
Painting over damp or seeping walls; Asian Paints notes that trapped moisture breaks the bond between paint and wall.
Skipping putty or primer on new or patchy plaster; Berger lists 1–2 putty coats and a primer coat for fresh painting.
Using distemper on walls that need regular wiping, such as kitchens and children's rooms; Nerolac describes it as less resistant to stains and moisture.
Rushing coats; AapkaPainter's 4–5 day estimate for a 2 BHK includes drying time between coats.
Pricing a whole flat at the texture rate; NoBroker describes texture paint as suited to statement or accent walls, and texture is priced per sq ft of the textured wall only.

Brand and product for walls and ceilings in each room
Fresh painting or repaint, with number of putty, primer and paint coats
Damp, crack and peeling-paint treatment
Doors, windows, grills and wardrobes: included or separate
Furniture moving, covering and cleanup
Number of painters, start date and duration
Written warranty and whether GST is included

faq.q: How much does interior painting cost per sq ft in Pune?
faq.a: Our draft models give these labour-and-material rates per sq ft of paintable area: distemper ₹7–₹20 (expected ₹12), entry-level emulsion ₹9–₹30 (₹15), premium emulsion ₹14–₹40 (₹22), lustre finish ₹26–₹35 (₹31), luxury emulsion ₹23–₹55 (₹35) and texture ₹80–₹400 (₹140). Several sources are national. Most Pune figures (NoBroker, AapkaPainter, HomeTriangle and IndiaMART listings) fall inside these ranges; AapkaPainter's Pune 'ultra-premium' finishes at ₹58–₹82 and the top of NoBroker's ₹12–₹60 emulsion range sit above them.

faq.q: How much more does fresh painting cost than a repaint?
faq.a: Fresh painting needs full putty work and primer. Our draft models put fresh painting at ₹18–₹62 per sq ft (expected ₹39) and a repaint at ₹12–₹53 (expected ₹30) when the paint grade is not specified. AapkaPainter says a repaint over sound walls costs 25–40% less and HomeTriangle 15–25% less.

faq.q: How do I estimate the area of my flat?
faq.a: Multiply carpet area by 2.5 to 3.5 (Asian Paints uses 2.5, AapkaPainter 3.2, NoBroker 3.5). Our presets use 3.2: about 1,600 sq ft for a 1 BHK, 2,400 for a 2 BHK, 3,520 for a 3 BHK and 6,400 for a 4 BHK. A quote should be based on measured walls and ceilings.

faq.q: How long does interior painting take?
faq.a: NoBroker gives about 3–5 days for a 2 BHK and 5–7 days for a 3 BHK, and up to 15 days in some cases. AapkaPainter says two painters finish a 2 BHK in 4–5 working days including drying time.

faq.q: Is texture priced for the whole flat?
faq.a: No. NoBroker describes texture paint as suited to statement or accent walls, and it is priced per sq ft of the textured wall only: ₹80–₹400 per sq ft in our draft model, depending on the texture type. The other walls are priced at the rate of the paint used on them.

common_mistakes: Painting during the monsoon or straight after rain; Berger advises waiting 24–48 hours after rainfall, and NoBroker notes that rain within about 4 hours of a coat can wash it off.
Painting over seepage instead of fixing the leak first; Asian Paints notes that moisture under the paint film leads to blistering and peeling.
Skipping crack repair and exterior primer; NoBroker's Apex example includes one primer coat and minor crack repairs before two top coats.
Comparing rates without checking whether scaffolding or rope access is included.

Choosing a product only on price without comparing the warranty periods manufacturers state; the Asian Paints product page title lists a 4-year warranty for Ace Exterior Emulsion, which AapkaPainter groups with economy paints.
Estimating paint by guesswork; NoBroker gives 55–65 sq ft per litre for two coats of Apex, so coverage should be checked against the measured area.

faq.q: How much does exterior painting cost per sq ft in Pune?
faq.a: Our draft models give these labour-and-material rates per sq ft of exterior wall: entry-level emulsion such as Ace ₹13–₹30 (expected ₹18), weatherproof emulsion such as Apex ₹18–₹45 (₹32), premium systems such as Apex Ultima or Ultima Protek ₹20–₹68 (₹37). There is no exterior texture model yet: AapkaPainter gives ₹55–₹85 per sq ft (labour and material, Chennai) and Nerolac about ₹60 for basic finishes, possibly without labour, so the two cannot be combined. AapkaPainter's Pune figures (₹26–₹40 standard, ₹42–₹68 premium) are higher than the national figures.

faq.q: Why does exterior painting cost more than interior painting?
faq.a: Asian Paints notes that outdoor surfaces need weather-resistant paint and more preparation, and HomeTriangle adds that exteriors often need scaffolding. HomeTriangle puts all-inclusive exterior rates at ₹13–₹50 per sq ft against ₹8–₹40 for interiors.

faq.q: What does an exterior repaint include?
faq.a: NoBroker's 1,000 sq ft Apex example includes one coat of exterior primer, two coats of weatherproof paint and minor crack repairs. AapkaPainter's exterior rates include surface preparation, primer, two coats and labour. Confirm whether scaffolding, algae treatment and grills are included.

faq.q: How much exterior paint will I need?
faq.a: NoBroker gives coverage of 55–65 sq ft per litre for two coats of Apex. At that rate, 1,500 sq ft of wall needs roughly 23–27 litres of top coat, plus primer. Check the coverage printed for the product you choose.

faq.q: How long does exterior painting take?
faq.a: NoBroker gives 2–6 days for a house exterior: 3–4 days for small to medium homes and 5–6 days for larger ones. Rain adds days, because Berger advises waiting 24–48 hours after rainfall before painting.
